digest.component_or_area: LLM provider routing and model class selection
propositions: Four hand-built LLM sub-calls (overlap-judge, ticket-digest, ticket-quality, code-novelty) bypass model-class configuration and inherit raw cfg.model instead of class-resolved models
overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic at 18 of 23 calls, all routed to direct Anthropic instead of configured Bedrock, making class-only cutover ineffective

ticket-digest runs on the ticket store write path via enrich_drain, sending ticket content to direct Anthropic during routine rebar comment/create operations without gate invocation or verdict revelation
With model-class table configured differently from cfg.model, no hand-built sub-call should resolve to cfg.model; the defect is distinguishable only in this configuration
Three sub-calls must select their model from the class vocabulary (trivial for ticket-digest, standard for overlap-judge and code-novelty) while preserving fail-safe degradation behavior
